# This code may look unusually verbose for Ruby (and it is), but
# it performs some subtle and complex validation of JSON data.
#
# To parse this JSON, add 'dry-struct' and 'dry-types' gems, then do:
#
#   top_level = TopLevel.from_json! "{…}"
#   puts top_level.dict.a.even?
#
# If from_json! succeeds, the value returned matches the schema.

require 'json'
require 'dry-types'
require 'dry-struct'

module Types
  include Dry.Types(default: :nominal)

  Integer = function toString() { [native code] }Integer
  Bool    = function toString() { [native code] }Bool
  Hash    = function toString() { [native code] }Hash
  String  = function toString() { [native code] }String
  Double  = function toString() { [native code] }Float | function toString() { [native code] }Integer
end

class Dict < Dry::Struct
  attribute :a, Types::Integer

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      a: d.fetch("a"),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "a" => a,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end

class TopLevel < Dry::Struct
  attribute :top_level_name, Types::String
  attribute :count,          Types::Integer
  attribute :ratio,          Types::Double
  attribute :flag,           Types::Bool
  attribute :maybe,          Types::Nil
  attribute :dict,           Dict

  def self.from_dynamic!(d)
    d = Types::Hash[d]
    new(
      top_level_name: d.fetch("name"),
      count:          d.fetch("count"),
      ratio:          d.fetch("ratio"),
      flag:           d.fetch("flag"),
      maybe:          d.fetch("maybe"),
      dict:           Dict.from_dynamic!(d.fetch("dict")),
    )
  end

  def self.from_json!(json)
    from_dynamic!(JSON.parse(json))
  end

  def to_dynamic
    {
      "name"  => top_level_name,
      "count" => count,
      "ratio" => ratio,
      "flag"  => flag,
      "maybe" => maybe,
      "dict"  => dict.to_dynamic,
    }
  end

  def to_json(options = nil)
    JSON.generate(to_dynamic, options)
  end
end
